Summary.en: Enables speech-to-text dictation in a text field via the Web Speech API.
Summary.de: Aktiviert Sprache-zu-Text-Diktat in einem Textfeld über die Web-Speech-API.
Summary.it: Abilita la dettatura vocale in un campo di testo tramite la Web Speech API.

Parameter.VoiceHotkey: Keyboard shortcut to toggle recording. Default: Alt+A.
Parameter.Language: BCP-47 language tag for recognition (e.g. de-DE, en-US). If omitted, the browser's default language is used.
Parameter.Placeholder: Custom placeholder text for the field. Default: the hotkey combo prefixed with a microphone emoji. Only shown when ShowHint is true.
Parameter.ShowHint: If set to true, shows the hotkey hint as placeholder text. Default: false.

VoiceHotkey.default: Keyboard shortcut to toggle recording. Default: Alt+A.

Language.default: BCP-47 language tag for recognition (e.g. de-DE, en-US). If omitted, the browser's default language is used.

ShowHint.default: if set to true, shows the hotkey hint as placeholder text. default: false.
